arguments.text: Strings to style. They are pasted with a space.

origin.details: With crayon.enabled TRUE, or on a color terminal, the string is wrapped in the style's open and close codes. A close code already inside the text is replaced by the open code, so an inner style hands control back to this one. With one color, the text is returned unchanged. Several strings of equal length, or length 1, are pasted with a space and styled element by element.

arguments.name: text
arguments.text: Strings or character vectors. A str is one element.

arguments.name: sep
arguments.text: Separator used when more than one argument is pasted. The default is a space.

translation.details: Call the style. Attribute access combines another style from styles(), so red.bold is red $ bold. Unary minus copies the style and, when color is on, uses the close code as the open code. options(crayon.enabled=True) turns color on in a non-interactive session.
translation.value: The styled string, or a list of strings when the pasted vector is longer than one.
